verdict.rationale: Gmail is a SaaS email service, so an official MCP server is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents only the REST Gmail API, push notifications, IMAP/SMTP, Workspace add-ons and Gemini features, and none of it mentions an official MCP server. The REST API is a developer building block, not the MCP server capability itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
